summary: Chemours filed an 8-K regarding a proposed Consent Decree with the EPA and WVDEP to resolve PFAS emission claims. Terms include a $22.5 million civil penalty payable in three annual installments, $90 million for mitigation projects over 15 years, and expanded drinking water projects. The settlement is subject to court approval and comment period; no admission of liability. This is a regulatory enforcement settlement, not a special situation corporate event.
